SELECT R.*, I.IMG_PATH FROM RALLY R INNER JOIN RALLY_IMG I ON R.RALLY_NO = I.RALLY_NO WHERE 1=1
AND ( R.RALLY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.RALLY_DATE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.APPLICATION_PERIOD LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.PRICE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.TYPE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.HOST LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY R.RALLY_NO DESC OFFSET ( (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize} ) ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
